basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 21-year-old college student currently based in Seattle, Washington. I'm majoring in psychology and have a keen interest in understanding human behavior, which is why games like Among Us fascinate me. In my free time, I love playing video games, crafting on Pinterest, and occasionally dabbling in dad jokes inspired by my favorite game, Final Fantasy XIV. I usually log onto Reddit in the evenings after classes, and I’m single but enjoying life with my friends and family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I gained my knowledge mainly through my coursework in psychology, which has given me insights into human behavior and social interactions. I also self-learn by playing social deduction games and participating in online forums to see theories in action.
